releases.summary: Tables get a default look (themed header, light or striped rows) and a new Table block with an editable grid that scrolls sideways on a phone.

changes.summary: A plain <table> in the content column is themed: a header row in the primary colour, thin dividers between rows, a bold caption. Add class="table--striped" for striped rows (every other row tinted with the theme's pale colour).
changes.notes: Pages are unaffected unless they contain a table, which then picks up the look when the base CSS is replaced. Tables that already carry Bootstrap's table classes get both.

changes.summary: New Table block: type the table into an editable grid (add or remove rows and columns), choose light or striped rows, header row and header column, and a caption. It is wrapped in a focusable, named box (class table-scroll) that scrolls sideways on a phone.
changes.notes: Pages are unaffected. Replace the base CSS for the table look, and add the Table block's CSS (the scrolling box) to use the block. A table that is not made by the block can be wrapped by hand: <div class="table-scroll" role="region" aria-label="..." tabindex="0">.

changes.summary: The content column and content body can shrink below their widest unbreakable content (min-width: 0), so a wide table or a very long address no longer widens the whole page; a scrolling box inside them does its job.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. Only pages with content wider than the column change: it now overflows (or scrolls, inside a table box) instead of pushing the grid wider.

releases.summary: Keyboard and motion fixes: a visible focus ring on icon tiles and clickable cards, icon tiles that announce open/closed and open with Space, no motion for people who ask for less, and Accordion ids that cannot clash between two accordions. No change to how a page looks.

changes.summary: People whose system asks for reduced motion get none: no smooth scrolling, and no card lift or arrow turn (transitions and animations are off inside #page-container). The back-to-top button and icon tiles scroll instantly for them.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the base JS. Nothing changes for anyone who has not asked for reduced motion.

changes.summary: Icon toggle tiles show a focus ring when reached with the keyboard (a div has none of its own), announce themselves as buttons that are expanded or collapsed (role=button, aria-expanded, aria-controls), and open with Space as well as Enter.
changes.notes: Replace the Icon toggle block's CSS and JS. The tile markup gains role="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="<panel id>"; rebuild the block or add them by hand. Pages with the old markup still work and get the focus ring and Space key; they just don't announce open or closed.

changes.summary: A numbered nav card (a whole-card link) shows a focus ring around the card when reached with the keyboard.
changes.notes: Replace the Nav cards block's CSS (inside #page-container).

changes.summary: A resource card (a whole-card link) shows a focus ring around the card when reached with the keyboard.
changes.notes: Replace the Resource cards block's CSS (inside #page-container).

changes.summary: Accordion item ids start with the accordion's own id (accordion-<group>-heading-<title>), so two accordions on one page with an item of the same name no longer share ids (the second used to toggle the first).
changes.notes: Only matters for pages with two accordions that share an item title. Rebuild the second one in the builder, or rename its ids by hand (the heading id, the panel id, and the three attributes that point at them: data-bs-target, aria-controls, aria-labelledby). The stored baselines hold no block HTML, so the checker cannot flag it.

releases.summary: New Figure block (a full-width image with a caption), a file type and size line for Resource cards and download links, a heading level for the Accordion, and Equal columns that take buttons in the right column.

changes.summary: New Figure block: one image at the full width of the content column, with an optional caption (<figure class="figure-block">). For charts and diagrams that Text around media would float at 275px.
changes.notes: Pages are unaffected. Use it for an informative image that must be readable; it warns when the alt text is empty.

changes.summary: Resource cards get an optional 'File type and size' field, written as (PDF, 21.5MB) directly under the title link. The new .file-size style in the base CSS (quiet text colour, normal weight, never underlined) also works after any download link in your own HTML.
changes.notes: Pages are unaffected. The base CSS gains a .file-size rule; copy the base CSS to use the class in your own HTML. Rich text cannot add the span yet: write it in the HTML.

changes.summary: The Accordion has a heading-level option (h3 by default, or h4 or h5), so its headers sit one level below the heading above them instead of always being h3.
changes.notes: Default output is unchanged. Choose h4 for an accordion under an h3. Only headings are offered: a non-heading tag would drop the items out of the page outline.

changes.summary: Equal columns can hold the Buttons block in the right column ('Another content block'): the buttons column is a fixed 280px so buttons match across groups, starts level with the text (no top margin), and on phones comes after the text rather than before it.
changes.notes: Replace the Equal columns block's CSS (inside #page-container). Only columns whose right-hand side holds .buttons look different; images and videos are unchanged.

changes.summary: Older Icon toggle markup (a plain <div id="data-icons-grid"> and tiles with onclick="openAccordion(...)" but no classes) is upgraded by the tool: it adds the data-icons-grid and data-icon-trigger classes the current CSS styles.
changes.notes: The migration and upgrade tools do this automatically and list it. By hand: add class="data-icons-grid" to the grid and class="data-icon-trigger" to each tile. Panel ids (info-gov-content) can stay as they are.

releases.summary: Accessibility and structure fixes found migrating real pages: no <main> inside the platform's own <main>, headings in a valid order, new-tab links say so to assistive technology, and nav-card buttons line up. No change to how a page looks.

changes.summary: The page's grid is a <div class="main-grid standard-container">, not a <main>. The platform's own shell already has a <main>, and two are invalid (audit NESTED-MAIN).

changes.summary: The At a glance heading is an <h2>, not an <h3>: it follows the page's <h1> directly, so an <h3> skipped a level (audit HEADING-SKIP).

changes.summary: Standard nav cards are equal-height columns with the button at the bottom; where the browser supports subgrid the cards in a row also share their icon, description and button rows, so the buttons start at the same height and are equally tall when a label wraps.
changes.notes: Replace the Nav cards block's CSS (inside #page-container). Adds display: flex; flex-direction: column to .nav-card and margin-top: auto to .nav-card__button (the fallback), and a @supports (grid-template-rows: subgrid) rule for standard cards. Phones (one column) are unchanged.

changes.summary: A Nav card that opens in a new tab says so to assistive technology: the button has aria-label="<label> (opens in a new tab)" (standard style) and the numbered card's link has it too. The decorative inline-icon class is no longer written.
changes.notes: Only needed for cards with 'opens in a new tab' ticked. Rebuild the block in the builder, or add the aria-label by hand. Nothing a reader sees changes. The stored baselines hold no block HTML, so the checker cannot flag it; it is listed here for people reading the notes.

changes.summary: A Resource card that opens in a new tab has aria-label="<title> (opens in a new tab)" on its link, as the Buttons block already did.
changes.notes: Only needed for cards with 'opens in a new tab' ticked. Rebuild the block, or add the aria-label by hand. Nothing a reader sees changes. The stored baselines hold CSS and JS, not block HTML, so the upgrade checker cannot flag it; it is listed here for people reading the release notes.

changes.summary: Links in rich text that open in a new tab carry a visually hidden " (opens in a new tab)" (Bootstrap's .visually-hidden) before the icon, and the icon is hidden from assistive technology. What a reader sees is unchanged. The decorative inline-icon class (which no CSS styled) is no longer written on these icons, nor on the Buttons block's.
changes.notes: Rebuild the block, or add (opens in a new tab) inside each target="_blank" link by hand. Pages that still carry the inline-icon class are unaffected: no CSS defines it. The stored baselines hold CSS and JS, not block HTML, so the upgrade checker cannot flag it; it is listed here for people reading the release notes.

changes.summary:
The date line in the base HTML is

Webpage last updated on [27th November 2025].

: one line with the date in its own element and no (the house style is 27th November 2025). Nothing is styled by the new class.
changes.notes: Pages with a real date need no change. If a page's date reads 27<sup>th</sup> November 2025, remove the <sup> and its tags by hand; the migration tool does this for pages it migrates.

releases.summary: The greys are named for what they are used for (--divider-colour, --secondary-text-colour, --hover-background, --tile-border-colour). --dark-grey, --light-grey and --mid-grey still work, as aliases, until 3.6.0. No visual change.

changes.summary: New tokens --divider-colour, --secondary-text-colour, --hover-background and --tile-border-colour, which the base CSS now uses for the breadcrumb divider, the breadcrumb's current page, the timestamp and the contents hover. --dark-grey, --light-grey and --mid-grey are kept as aliases of them. The colours are unchanged.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: The Icon toggle tile border uses var(--tile-border-colour).
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

releases.summary: Neutral colours are tokens named for what they are used for (--page-background, --text-on-primary, --subheading-colour, --card-text-colour, --focus-ring-colour, --panel-background, --shadow-colour, --floating-button-background), instead of hard-coded values. No visual change, except that nav-card headings are black instead of #1a1a1a.

changes.summary: The base CSS defines the usage-named neutral colour tokens, and uses them for the page background, the contents heading text, the content-column sub-headings and the back-to-top button. The colours are unchanged.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: The accordion focus ring uses var(--focus-ring-colour).
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: The At a glance panel background uses var(--panel-background).
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: Button text uses var(--text-on-primary).
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: Icon toggle tile shadows use var(--shadow-colour). The shadows look the same.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: Nav card text, button text and shadow use var(--card-text-colour), var(--text-on-primary) and var(--shadow-colour). The headings of numbered cards were #1a1a1a and are now black, like the card text.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

changes.summary: Resource card shadows use var(--shadow-colour). The hover shadow was a different near-black (26, 26, 26) and is now the same shadow colour as the others: a difference nobody can see.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together: the blocks now read the new tokens, so mixing versions would leave those colours undefined.

releases.summary: Icon toggle tiles show the pointer cursor on the tile itself.

changes.summary: The Icon toggle tile (.data-icon-card) sets the pointer cursor itself. Before, only its wrapper (.data-icon-trigger) did, so tiles built with older markup, which has no trigger class, did not look clickable.
changes.notes: Replace the Icon toggle block's CSS (inside #page-container). Pages built with the current markup look the same either way, because the cursor was already inherited from the wrapper.

releases.summary: Section block gets a "directly below the page title" option (the tight-heading class), and the At a glance heading keeps its theme colour.

changes.summary: New Section option: "This section comes directly below the page title". When ticked the heading gets class="tight-heading", which closes the gap under the H1.
changes.notes: Off by default, so existing sections are unchanged. The class needs base CSS 3.2.0 or later. To use it on an existing page, replace the base CSS, then add class="tight-heading" to the H2 by hand or rebuild the section.

changes.summary: The At a glance heading sets its own theme colour. In 3.2.0 the content-column H3 became black, which also turned this heading black.
changes.notes: Replace the At a glance block's CSS (inside #page-container) together with the base CSS. Pages still on a base before 3.2.0 are themed already; this keeps them themed once they take the new base.

releases.summary: Base CSS refinements (numbered lists, sub-heading colour, wider contents column, bordered contents items, a tight-heading class) and a visible keyboard focus ring on the Accordion.

changes.summary: Numbered lists get the same vertical spacing as paragraphs and bullet lists, and their numbers are bold.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. Adds margin-block: 1em on ol and a bold ::marker on ol > li. The breadcrumb list is unaffected: it resets its own margin and has no markers.

changes.summary: Sub-headings (H3) in the content column are black instead of the theme colour.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. Only the plain .content-column h3 changes. Image and text sections and accordion buttons set their own colour and are unchanged.

changes.summary: New .tight-heading class: put it on an H2 that sits directly below the page title (H1) to close the gap between them.
changes.notes: Pages without it are unaffected. To use it on an existing page, replace the base CSS first, then add class="tight-heading" to the H2 (h2.tight-heading). The base H1 margin is deliberately unchanged, so pages with an At a glance box keep their spacing.

changes.summary: The contents column is a little wider (1.3fr to 3fr instead of 1fr to 3fr), so long contents labels wrap less.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. Pages built without a contents list are unaffected (they only have the single-column rule, so they are not flagged).

changes.summary: Contents items get a 1px border in the theme colour.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. The background stays on var(--secondary-colour) so both themes keep their own tint.

changes.summary: Accordion buttons show a visible black focus ring for keyboard users. The block removed Bootstrap's own focus shadow, which left nothing visible.
changes.notes: Replace the Accordion block's CSS (inside #page-container). Pages are only affected if they use the Accordion.

releases.summary: Patch: the page container background is set explicitly to white, so the supplier's grey default no longer shows.

changes.summary: The #page-container background is set to white. The supplier's default page background changed to grey, so pages built on the base CSS showed grey.
changes.notes: Replace the base CSS. In the #page-container block, background-color must be white !important. Pages on 3.1.0 have it as transparent, which is the line to change.

releases.summary: First set of updates on version 3.0.0: colour tokens, theme toggle, two-column block, mobile layout fixes, ordered list numbering, link rel handling, back-to-top icon, nav card and upgrade tooling.

changes.summary: Colour tokens renamed to the template's names: --navy, --green and --burgundy become --primary-colour; --tertiary-colour becomes --secondary-colour. The old --secondary-colour (navy) is removed, so the name --secondary-colour now means a different colour.
changes.notes: Pages are self-consistent with their own pasted CSS, so they only break if base CSS and block CSS are mixed from different versions. Replace the base CSS and the CSS of every block on the page together. No deprecation aliases existed for this change, so it cannot be done gradually. Note that --secondary-colour changed meaning. It is not a detection pattern, because new pages use it too: check pages that set it by hand.

changes.summary: Ordered lists show their numbers again. The platform strips them from <ol> elements, so the base CSS now restores decimal numbering.
changes.notes: Only pages with ordered lists are affected.

changes.summary: Double quotes in headings, labels, URLs and alt text are now escaped. Previously they broke the generated attributes.
changes.notes: Only pages containing a double quote in an attribute value are affected. Replace each such quote with ". Most pages have none.

changes.summary: rel="noopener noreferrer" is now added only to external links opening in a new tab. Internal links keep target="_blank" alone.
changes.notes: Older pages still carry rel on internal links. That is harmless, so no page change is needed.

changes.summary: The back-to-top button uses the Font Awesome circle-chevron-up icon, coloured with the primary colour, instead of an image.
changes.notes: Requires Font Awesome 7, which the base HTML already loads.

changes.summary: Flexible content: images are vertically centred on desktop, and on mobile they stack image-first, at 3:2, full width and centred.
changes.notes: Copy the block's CSS. The HTML is unchanged.

changes.summary: Image-text: on mobile, 3:2 images are full width, centred and show the top of the image.
changes.notes: Copy the block's CSS. The HTML is unchanged.

changes.summary: New two-column layout block, with media on the left by default and a flip option.
changes.notes: Existing pages are unaffected. Pages can adopt the block when they are next edited.

changes.summary: Buttons: fixed 250px width by default, centred and wrapping. Inside a two-column or flexible-content block they are full width and stacked.
changes.notes: Copy the block's CSS. The HTML is unchanged.

changes.summary: Nav cards: link URL and new-tab settings are shared between the two styles. Generate warns when a style has no usable cards.
changes.notes: Form change only. Output is unchanged.

changes.summary: Base HTML, CSS and JS carry a version header, and the page container carries data-base-version.
changes.notes: Pages without the marker are checked against the version chosen in the upgrade tab.

releases.summary: ORIGIN. The information-hub template page (leadershipportal.thinqi-uat.co.uk/templates/information-hub) as received. Its code is stored unmodified in baseline/3.0.0/. Every later change is recorded against this point.
